messages:
zoe: Follow-up from today's infra all-hands: post quick Qs about GPU regions, autoscale behaviour, and customer comms here. We'll answer live. :wave:

simon: Short summary: H100 primary for US/EMEA; APAC mixed A100/H100. First APAC racks expected late June. Rolling beta for Dedicated, hosted to follow once autoscale is validated.

nolan: Can teams request region reservation for Hosted during the beta? Some customers need APAC low-latency now.

simon: Well offer limited region reservations to paid orgs via quota requests. Submit via the Console request form; EngInfra will review and approve based on capacity.

harini: How will cross-region fallback be surfaced to customers? Need exact fields for support messages.

simon: Console will show a "region_fallback" banner on the route page with fallback_reason (capacity|maintenance) and latency_delta_ms estimate. Also emits an audit event.

marta: Autoscale question: will Dedicated have scale-from-zero for batch vs serving?

simon: Yes  Dedicated supports scale-from-zero for non-realtime batch jobs. For serving, Dedicated can use warm pools; scale-from-zero is opt-in per deployment.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: infra/autoscale-config.yml applied to staging at 2026-05-02T11:05Z :white_check_mark:

zoe: Action items: Simon/EngInfra to post a short FAQ + per-region rollout windows by EOD Thursday. Harini to draft customer-facing blurb about fallback latency. We'll pin both to the all-hands notes. If anything else, drop here or DM. :thumbsup:
